title: Head and Meta
story: The <head> is not shown on the page, but it tells the browser and search engines about it: the title, the character set and a description.
goal: In the head add a title Aata Village, a meta description of at least 20 characters, and the viewport meta so phones show the page at the right size.
starter: Aata Village

tests.label: A description of at least 20 characters
tests.js: var c = attr("meta[name=description]","content") || ""; return c.trim().length >= 20 || "description has " + c.length + " characters"

hints: The viewport tag is <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.
Aata Village
socratic: Why is the description not shown on the page?
What would a phone do without the viewport tag?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Head and Meta”?
solution: Aata Village
